name: @pipeworx/mcp-postscript

tools.name: postscript_list_subscribers
tools.description: List SMS subscribers for a Postscript (Shopify) shop. Supports filtering by email, phone number, Shopify customer ID, and created/updated timestamps, plus sorting. Page-based pagination: returns { page_info: { page, total_pages }, subscribers: [...] }; pass page to walk results.

_apiKey.description: Postscript Private API token (Bearer). From Settings → API.

page.description: 1-indexed page number (default 1). Walk until page === page_info.total_pages.

created_at__gte.description: ISO timestamp; subscribers created on/after this time.

created_at__lte.description: ISO timestamp; subscribers created on/before this time.

updated_at__gte.description: ISO timestamp; subscribers updated on/after this time.

tools.name: postscript_get_subscriber
tools.description: Get a single SMS subscriber by Postscript subscriber ID. Returns phone number, email, subscription status, Shopify customer linkage, and custom properties.

tools.name: postscript_list_keywords
tools.description: List all active SMS keywords for the shop. Keywords are the text-to-join words (e.g. "JOIN") subscribers text to opt in. Returns keyword IDs, the keyword text, and associated subscription settings.

tools.name: postscript_get_keyword
tools.description: Get a single SMS keyword by its ID. Returns the keyword text, status, and configuration (welcome message, list assignment).

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-postscript forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the postscript pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
